description: QuickSight parameter ref ${param} degradation (beads-sigma-n730). A dataset-level CreateColumnsOperation and an analysis-level CalculatedField both reference a QS parameter (${OTThreshold}). The parameter is emitted as a Sigma control (params >= 1); the dependent calcs degrade to a valid 'Null' formula (original expr preserved in description) so the WHOLE model POSTs cleanly with zero error columns — instead of stranding a dangling '$[...]' that errors the column and breaks the POST.
